```{r}
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  # Total number of unique combinations possible
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)
  if (n > max_combinations) stop(paste("n exceeds total unique combinations:", max_combinations))
  
  seen <- list()
  result <- list()
  
  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(function(mx) sample(1:mx, size = 1), POSITION_MAX)
    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")
    
    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }
  
  result
}
```

```{r}
tb <- tapho_db %>%
  # keep metadata + the two list-cols we want; drop site_id & taphonomic_context,
  # and (by not selecting them) every other list-col and everything
  # after OverallProportionalRep_assemblage
  dplyr::select(site_name:sum_count, ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased,
                -site_id, -taphonomic_context) %>%
  # name each row's vector by that row's own element names
  dplyr::mutate(
    ReMNAU = lapply(seq_along(ReMNAU), function(i)
      setNames(ReMNAU[[i]], tapho_db$element[[i]])),
    ProportionalRep_MNIbased = lapply(seq_along(ProportionalRep_MNIbased), function(i)
      setNames(ProportionalRep_MNIbased[[i]], tapho_db$element[[i]]))
  ) %>%
  # spread both wide; names_sep prefixes so the shared element names don't clash
  tidyr::unnest_wider(c(ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased), names_sep = "_")

colnames(tb)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# the OTHER list-columns to remove (keep ReMNAU & ProportionalRep_MNIbased)
list_cols_drop <- c(
  "bone.level", "element", "One_Skeleton_count", "Skeleton_Section",
  "MNE", "MNAU", "MAU", "PercentMAU", "PercentMNAU", "AcReMNAU",
  "CumulativeReMNAU", "MNI_used_assemblage", "Mean_MNAU_assemblage",
  "Mean_part_abundance", "OverallProportionalRep_assemblage"
)

# name a row's value vector by its element labels,
# dropping slots whose label is missing/empty/purely numeric
name_by_element <- function(vec, elems) {
  v  <- setNames(vec, elems)
  nm <- names(v)
  v[!is.na(nm) & nm != "" & !grepl("^[0-9]+$", nm)]
}

tb <- tapho_db %>%
  mutate(
    ReMNAU = lapply(seq_along(ReMNAU),
                    \(i) name_by_element(ReMNAU[[i]], element[[i]])),
    ProportionalRep_MNIbased = lapply(seq_along(ProportionalRep_MNIbased),
                    \(i) name_by_element(ProportionalRep_MNIbased[[i]], element[[i]]))
  ) %>%
  select(-all_of(list_cols_drop)) %>%       # drop other list-cols, keep engineered features
  unnest_wider(c(ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased), names_sep = "_")
tb
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
k <- 1
# list-columns to keep, name by element, and widen
feature_cols <- c(
  "MNE", "MNAU", "MAU", "PercentMAU", "PercentMNAU",
  "ReMNAU", "AcReMNAU", "CumulativeReMNAU",
  "ProportionalRep_MNIbased"
)

# other list-columns to remove
list_cols_drop <- c(
  "bone.level", "element", "One_Skeleton_count", "Skeleton_Section",
  "MNI_used_assemblage", "Mean_MNAU_assemblage",
  "Mean_part_abundance", "OverallProportionalRep_assemblage"
)

# name a row's value vector by its element labels,
# dropping slots whose label is missing/empty/purely numeric
name_by_element <- function(vec, elems) {
  v  <- setNames(vec, elems)
  nm <- names(v)

  v[!is.na(nm) & nm != "" & !grepl("^[0-9]+$", nm)]
}

tb <- tapho_db %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(feature_cols),
      ~ Map(name_by_element, .x, element)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(list_cols_drop)) %>%
  unnest_wider(
    all_of(feature_cols),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

print(tb)

#tail(colnames(tb), 220)
colnames(tb)
#  (sum_count:mne_cranium) all between exluding the listes names
```

```{r}
source("tapho_loader_new.R")
source("tapho_loader_wfl_features.R")

excel_path   <- "hspa-test.xlsx"
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

elementwise_cols <- c("MNE", "MNAU", "MAU", "PercentMAU", "PercentMNAU",
                      "ReMNAU", "AcReMNAU", "CumulativeReMNAU",
                      "ProportionalRep_MNIbased")            # the 9-col block
firstentry_cols  <- c("Mean_MNAU_assemblage", "Mean_part_abundance",
                      "OverallProportionalRep_assemblage")   # repeated-value lists

# pull the single value out of a cell whether it's a list-col or already atomic
first_val <- function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) vapply(x, function(e) as.numeric(e[[1]]), numeric(1))
  else as.numeric(x)
}

tb_by_level <- vector("list", 5)

system.time({
  for (k in 1:5) {
    lvl <- pmin(k, POSITION_MAX)
    cat("Step", k, ":", lvl, "\n")

    result <- tapho.loader.wfl.features(excel_path, level = lvl)

    # ---- assemble tapho_db exactly as before ----
    appended <- dplyr::filter(result$db_id, count_type == FALSE) |>
      dplyr::mutate(site_id = as.character(site_id))
    tapho_db <- dplyr::bind_rows(result$db_sum, appended)

    # ---- piece 1: metadata (46 x 7), no suffix ----
    meta <- tapho_db %>%
      dplyr::select(site_name:sum_count, -site_id, -taphonomic_context)

    # ---- piece 2: the 9 feature cols, one value per row, suffixed _lvl_k ----
    feat <- tapho_db %>%
      dplyr::transmute(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(elementwise_cols), first_val)) %>%
      dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_lvl_", k))

    # ---- piece 3: the 3 repeated-value cols, first entry only, suffixed _lvl_k ----
    firsts <- tapho_db %>%
      dplyr::transmute(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(firstentry_cols), first_val)) %>%
      dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_lvl_", k))

    # ---- 46 x 3  +  46 x 7  +  46 x 9  ->  46 x 19 ----
    tb_by_level[[k]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(meta, feat, firsts)
  }
})

# horizontal append across all k: keep metadata once, add each level's columns
tb <- purrr::reduce(seq_along(tb_by_level), function(acc, k) {
  if (k == 1) return(tb_by_level[[k]])
  dplyr::bind_cols(acc, dplyr::select(tb_by_level[[k]], dplyr::ends_with(paste0("_lvl_", k))))
}, .init = NULL)
```
